info.long_name: Lab Component Results for babesia
info.short_description: Monthly count of lab component results for babesia testing.
info.long_description: Count of lab component results for babesia, per Epic's "n babesia" measure, per month (`time` = last day of the month; SlicerDicer session 2863670, data model Lab Component Results, Country of Care = United States of America). Only full calendar years are kept - the partial current year (e.g. "Jan 1 - Sep 8 2026") is dropped. Counts are lab component results, not patients. Counts of 10 or fewer are suppressed by Epic (reported blank) and imputed as 5; see epic_tests_babesiosis_suppressed_flag.
info.statement: In {location}, {value} lab component results were recorded for babesia testing.

info.long_name: Percent of Lab Component Results for babesia
info.short_description: Percent of all lab component results that were for babesia testing.
info.long_description: Computed as epic_n_tests_babesiosis / epic_n_lab_results * 100 - a percent of ALL lab component results (every test type), not a positivity rate and not a rate per 100,000. Monthly. Where the numerator was suppressed it is imputed as 5 before the percentage is computed. Where the denominator was itself suppressed the percentage is left missing; those cells are marked by epic_n_lab_results_suppressed_flag.
info.statement: In {location}, {value}% of lab component results were for babesia testing.

info.long_name: Suppression flag for the babesia lab-result numerator (count and percent)
info.short_description: Indicates whether the babesia lab-result count was suppressed and imputed; applies to both epic_n_tests_babesiosis and epic_pct_tests_babesiosis.
info.long_description: 1 when Epic Cosmos suppressed the babesia cell (a count of 10 or fewer, reported blank) and epic_n_tests_babesiosis was imputed as 5; 0 otherwise. Suppression of the denominator is tracked separately by epic_n_lab_results_suppressed_flag.

info.long_name: Patients with a new Lyme disease diagnosis
info.short_description: Monthly count of patients with a new Lyme disease diagnosis.
info.long_description: Monthly count of patients with a new Lyme disease diagnosis. Monthly (Year > Month > State of Residence) export from Epic Cosmos SlicerDicer session 2863672 (new cases, population filter): the population is restricted to patients with a first diagnosis (not preceded by the same diagnosis within 6 months) of Lyme disease, babesiosis, malaria, RMSF, West Nile virus or dengue, Country of Care = United States of America, Has Any Encounters. Counts of 10 or fewer are suppressed by Epic (blank or "10 or fewer") and imputed as 5; see epic_new_lyme_suppressed_flag.
info.statement: In {location}, {value} patients had a new Lyme disease diagnosis in the month.

info.short_name: New Lyme disease percent of filtered patients
info.long_name: Percent of filtered patients with a new Lyme disease diagnosis
info.short_description: Monthly percent of patients in the new-diagnosis population with a new Lyme disease diagnosis.
info.long_description: Computed as epic_n_new_lyme / epic_n_new_patients * 100. The denominator is the filtered population (patients with a new diagnosis of any of the six diseases), NOT all patients, so this is a share among patients with a new vector-borne diagnosis and is not comparable to epic_pct_new_lyme. Left missing where the denominator was suppressed. Monthly (Year > Month > State of Residence) export from Epic Cosmos SlicerDicer session 2863672 (new cases, population filter): the population is restricted to patients with a first diagnosis (not preceded by the same diagnosis within 6 months) of Lyme disease, babesiosis, malaria, RMSF, West Nile virus or dengue, Country of Care = United States of America, Has Any Encounters.
info.statement: In {location}, {value}% of patients with a new vector-borne diagnosis had a new Lyme disease diagnosis.

info.long_name: Suppression flag for the new Lyme disease numerator
info.short_description: Indicates whether the numerator was suppressed and imputed; applies to both epic_n_new_lyme and epic_pct_new_lyme .
info.long_description: 1 when Epic Cosmos suppressed the cell (10 or fewer, blank or "10 or fewer") and epic_n_new_lyme was imputed as 5; 0 otherwise.

epic_cosmos.name: Epic Cosmos
epic_cosmos.description: Epic Cosmos is a collaborative research platform containing de-identified patient data from over 300 million patients across more than 1,600 hospitals and health systems using Epic electronic health record systems. Data is accessed via SlicerDicer, a self-service analytics tool. The dataset includes emergency department visits, diagnoses, immunizations, laboratory results, and other clinical data. Due to privacy protections, counts fewer than 10 are suppressed and imputed. Coverage extends across all U.S. states and territories. Note that county-level and city-level stratifications could differ markedly in total sample size due to high levels of missingness of county data in some states.
epic_cosmos.restrictions: The data can be re-used with appropriate attribution. A suggested citation relating to this data is 'Results of research performed with Epic Cosmos were obtained from the PopHIVE platform (https://github.com/PopHIVE/Ingest).'
